{{Quote|I have recommended an increase in patrols along the region. I will lead the sweeps in the ''Triumphant'' and maintain constant communication.|Plo Koon volunteers to lead a hunt for the ''Malevolence'' with the ''Triumphant''|<ref name="SD" />}}
The '''''Triumphant''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] as [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the ''Triumphant'' was part of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] strike force of three [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] tasked with hunting down the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy's]] new [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]], the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], which had committed several attacks on Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. After tracking the ''Malevolence'' to the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]], the ''Triumphant'' and the rest of Koon's fleet were [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|assaulted]] by the Separatist [[Warship/Legends|warship]], which used one of its [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]] to disable the entire fleet's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. Completely defenseless, Koon's [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] was destroyed by the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], although Koon and some of the ''Triumphant''{{'s}} [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] crew were able to escape in the Star [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer's]] [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] before the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was completely obliterated.

==Description==
{{Quote|We're losing all our power&hellip; That energy field has left us ''defenseless!''|Commander Wolffe, after the ''Malevolence'' fires one of its ion cannons at the ''Triumphant''|audio=LeftUsDefenseless.flac|<ref name="RM" />}}
Manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]],<ref name="Databank" /> the ''Triumphant'' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="RM" /> Measuring 1,137 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length,<ref name="Databank" /> the ''Triumphant'' had eight [[Engine/Legends|engines]] equipped, a pair of [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command towers]], and a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] communications system installed in one of the bridge structures. The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] had at least one [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] installed<ref name="RM" /> and had an armament of fifty-two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], eight [[DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turret/Legends|DBY-827 heavy dual turbolaser turrets]], two medium dual [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons, four [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] tubes, and six [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors.<ref name="Databank" /> However, none of the defensive systems were able to withstand fire from an [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannon]], which was capable of disabling the ''Triumphant''{{'s}} electrical systems and leaving the ship vulnerable to attack. The ''Triumphant'' also had several [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] that could be launched manually, even if the [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer's]] electrical systems were rendered inactive.<ref name="RM" />

==History==
{{Quote|And we have had no further contact with General Plo Koon. The absence of distress beacons indicates that his fleet was&hellip; that his fleet was destroyed, like the others. We are about to prepare a rescue mission.|Anakin Skywalker, to Supreme Chancellor Palpatine and the Jedi High Council, following the loss of the ''Triumphant'' and the rest of Plo Koon's fleet|audio=NoFurtherContactRescueMission.flac|<ref name="RM" />}}
During the Clone Wars against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the ''Triumphant'' served as [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] and [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] member [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]],<ref name="RM" /> while [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]] served as the Star Destroyer's second-in-command.<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011" /> the Confederacy manufactured the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Under the command of the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the ''Malevolence'' ambushed Republic [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] everyone onboard and vanishing before the Republic could discover what exactly had attacked their ships.<ref name="RM" /> Among the attacks executed by the ''Malevolence'' was the [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|annihilation]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Phu system/Legends|Phu system]].<ref name="SD" />

[[File:AbregadoSystem-RM.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Triumphant'' and the rest of Koon's task force approach the ''Malevolence''.]]
After the loss of Nune's fleet, Koon and the rest of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] met with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to discuss the growing Separatist threat. During the meeting, Koon volunteered to lead a strike force from the ''Triumphant'' and hunt down the ''Malevolence''. Although Koon planned to stay in constant contact with nearby Republic forces during the operation, Palpatine and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] believed it was still going to be a very dangerous mission.<ref name="SD" /> Koon's task of finding and eliminating the ''Malevolence'' was soon reported by the Republic's [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], and the ''Triumphant''{{'s}} participation was included in the report.<ref name="A Galaxy Divided">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>

After being dispatched on its assignment, Koon's task force, which consisted of the ''Triumphant'' and two other ''Venator''-class [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], tracked the ''Malevolence'' to the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]]. The Republic fleet slowly approached the distant ''Malevolence'', with plans to assault the enemy vessel. Within one of the ''Triumphant''{{'s}} command towers, Koon and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Wolffe contacted Jedi General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who were stationed in the nearby [[Bith system/Legends|Bith system]], and updated the two on their situation. However, Skywalker informed Koon that he could not assist Koon's [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] in the upcoming [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|battle]] because Skywalker himself had been ordered to secure the Bith [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Shortly thereafter, their communications were cut off, a result of being [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] by the ''Malevolence''.<ref name="RM" />

Aboard his ''Subjugator''-class flagship, Grievous and the leader of the Separatist movement, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]&mdash;who was present onboard at the time to observe the ''Malevolence'' in action&mdash;saw the arrival of the ''Triumphant'' and its support vessels as another opportunity to test the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} powerful [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion]] pulse cannons. The new weapons were capable of disabling the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] on any ship, leaving vessels completely defenseless and vulnerable to [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire. Grievous moved the ''Malevolence'' into attack position and ordered his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] crew to charge the ship's port-side pulse cannon.<ref name="RM" />

[[File:Triumphant_ion_blasted.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Triumphant'' is hit by the ion blast from the ''Malevolence''.]]
Unable to direct laser fire at the ''Malevolence'' because it was out of range, the ''Triumphant'' and the rest of Koon's task force fell prey to the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} ion pulse assault. The ''Triumphant''{{'s}} crew braced for impact as the enemy's ion pulse hit the entire strike force, deactivating the Star Destroyers' shields and weapon systems. The ''Malevolence'' immediately moved in closer to the unprotected Republic fleet and fired at the Star Destroyers with its many turbolasers. Realizing that the battle was lost, Koon ordered the ship's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] crew to its escape pods just as his fleet was torn apart, and a number of the ''Triumphant''{{'s}} crew survived by fleeing in the vessels' escape pods. Among the survivors were Wolffe, Koon, and two [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]] and [[Boost/Legends|Boost]]; all four escaped in the same pod.<ref name="RM" />

After the obliteration of the ''Triumphant'' and the rest of Koon's flotilla, the remains of the three Star Destroyers formed a debris field around the Abregado system, with the surviving escape pods&mdash;lacking power, communications, and [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems&mdash;floating around within the field. Not intending to leave any witnesses of the battle, Dooku dispatched a number of [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droids]] aboard [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]] to eliminate any remaining Republic escape pods. All of the ''Triumphant''{{'s}} surviving crew members were killed by the Separatist teams, with the exception of the occupants of Koon's pod, who were able to defeat a battle [[Droid/Legends|droid]] patrol that attacked them. Koon's pod was soon rescued by Skywalker and Tano&mdash;who had come to investigate the situation at Abregado following their loss of contact with Koon's task force&mdash;aboard Skywalker's personal [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']].<ref name="RM" />

==Commanders and crew==
{{Quote|Do you think we have a chance, General?''"<br />"''I don't believe in chance, Commander. I know if we work together, we will stay alive, and someone ''will'' find us.|Wolffe and Plo Koon, following the destruction of the ''Triumphant''|<ref name="RM" />}}
[[File:Wolffe_Koon.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Koon and Wolffe aboard the ''Triumphant'']]
The ''Triumphant'' was the flagship of Jedi Master Plo Koon,<ref name="RM" /> with Clone Commander Wolffe serving as the Star Destroyer's [[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]].<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide" /> The ''Triumphant'' was mostly crewed by the clone troopers of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], including the "[[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]],"<ref name="Rising Malevolence Decoded">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''|d=y}}</ref> a close-knit [[Squad/Legends|squad]]<ref name="TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> led by Wolffe that included Boost and [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] Sinker.<ref name="Rising Malevolence Decoded" /> When the ''Triumphant'' was destroyed by the ''Malevolence'', most of the ship's crew was killed, and the few who did escape were dispatched by the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} pod hunters. The only exceptions were Koon, Wolffe, Boost, and Sinker, who escaped the Abregado system with Skywalker and Tano aboard the ''Twilight''.<ref name="RM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Triumphant'' was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' publication, released on [[July 26]], [[2008]]. On [[October 3]], 2008, the Star Destroyer made its first appearance in "[[Ambush]]," the premiere episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, though it was only shown briefly in the episode's opening newsreel. The ''Triumphant'' later played a main role in the second episode of the series, "[[Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence'']]"&mdash;which aired the same day as "Ambush"&mdash;being destroyed early on in the episode.
